api.name: addBusinessDays
api.summary: Add signed calendar business days, excluding the starting date and preserving clock time.

api.name: addCustomHolidays
api.signature: function addCustomHolidays(holidayArray: (Date | string | number)[]): void
api.summary: Adds custom holidays

api.name: addHolidayRules
api.signature: function addHolidayRules(country: string, rules: HolidayRule[]): void
api.summary: Replaces a country preset with copied rules. Fixed dates use MM-DD; floating rules are functions returning a valid date in the requested year.

api.name: addTime
api.summary: Hours and smaller units are elapsed time. Days and larger units are calendar arithmetic; month/year additions clamp to the last valid day. Explicit timezone calendar operations reject DST gaps/folds. Calendar amounts must be integers.

api.name: addWorkingHours
api.summary: Consume nonnegative elapsed working hours, starting at or after the input. Supports partial days, overnight schedules and absent days (all days). Empty/zero-length schedules are rejected. Search is bounded to 100,000 iterations.

api.name: businessDaysInMonth
api.signature: function businessDaysInMonth(year: number, month: number): number
api.summary: Counts the number of business days in a given month

api.name: calculateAdvancedDuration
api.summary: Absolute calendar decomposition. Supported display units: year, month, day, hour, minute, second. Default precision 2. Omitted larger components are not converted into smaller units.

api.name: calculateAge
api.summary: Age calculator that handles leap years and different formats

api.name: calculateBusinessDaysAdvanced
api.summary: Inclusive calendar days in config.timezone (host timezone by default). Honors workingDays, excludeHolidays and holidayConfig.

api.name: calculateBusinessDaysCustom
api.summary: Excludes the start date and includes the end date. Global/custom holidays are combined with the supplied holidays. Reversed ranges return 0. workingHours is rejected; use calculateWorkingHours.

api.name: calculateOvertime
api.summary: Returns pay factors assuming hourly rate 1. Explicit thresholds are arithmetic inputs, not jurisdiction-specific payroll rules.

api.name: calculateProjectMilestones
api.summary: Calculates project milestones based on working days

api.name: calculateSLACompliance
api.summary: Calculates service level agreement (SLA) compliance

api.name: calculateWorkingHours
api.summary: Overlap with half-open [start,end) work intervals. Supports fractional hours, overnight intervals (endHour < startHour), explicit timezone and configured holiday exclusion. The shift belongs to its starting calendar day. DST-ambiguous boundaries throw.

api.name: CalendarDate
api.summary: A calendar date without time information

api.name: ChronoUtilzError
api.summary: ChronoUtilz error class

api.name: cloneDate
api.signature: function cloneDate(date: Date | string | number): Date
api.summary: Creates a deep copy of a Date object

api.name: compareDates
api.summary: Compares two dates and returns -1, 0, or 1

api.name: compareDetailed
api.summary: Absolute calendar decomposition: clamped years, then clamped months, calendar days, then elapsed sub-day remainder. Direction is reported separately.

api.name: configureHolidays
api.signature: function configureHolidays(holidays: (Date | string | number)[]): BusinessDayConfig
api.summary: Adds holidays to the business day configuration

api.name: configureTimezone
api.summary: Configure global timezone behavior for ChronoUtilz

api.name: configureWorkingDays
api.signature: function configureWorkingDays(dayArray: number[]): BusinessDayConfig
api.summary: Configures which days of the week are considered working days

api.name: convertTimezone
api.summary: Default: return a new Date with the same instant, validating the zones. preserveTime:true reinterprets source-zone wall fields in the target zone. Use formatDate/formatTimezone to display a zone. Gap/fold reinterpretations throw.

api.name: copyTime
api.signature: function copyTime(fromDate: Date | string | number, toDate: Date | string | number): Date
api.summary: Copies the time portion (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) from one date to another

api.name: createDate
api.signature:
function createDate(
  year: number,
  month: number,
  day: number,
  hours = 0,
  minutes = 0,
  seconds = 0,
  milliseconds = 0,
): Date
api.summary: Creates a date from components

api.name: differenceInBusinessDays
api.summary: Signed local calendar-day count. Forward ranges exclude the first date and include the last; reversed ranges negate the corresponding ordered interval.

api.name: endOf
api.summary: Gets the end of a time unit (e.g., end of day, end of month)

api.name: findClosestDate
api.summary: Finds the closest date to a target from an array of dates

api.name: formatCalendar
api.signature: function formatCalendar(date: Date | string | number, baseDate?: Date): string
api.summary: Formats date as calendar format (Today, Tomorrow, etc.)

api.name: formatCustom
api.signature: function formatCustom(date: Date | string | number, pattern: string): string
api.summary: Single-pass token substitution with [literal text] escaping. Supported tokens are listed by getConfigs().formatTokens; d (weekday number) is also supported. Uses host local fields.

api.name: formatDate
api.summary: The eight DateFormat patterns only. Displays an instant in the explicit or globally effective timezone. Strings are parsed first; configureTimezone does not change parsing of offset-free strings.

api.name: formatDuration
api.summary: Elapsed approximation: 365-day years and 30-day months. Negative values retain a minus sign. maxUnits must be a positive integer.

api.name: formatISO
api.summary: UTC ISO output. includeTimezone:false removes the Z marker; remaining fields still represent UTC.

api.name: formatLocalized
api.summary: Formats date with localization support

api.name: formatRelativeLocalized
api.summary: Formats relative time with localization

api.name: formatTimezone
api.summary: Formats date in a specific timezone

api.name: fromTimestamp
api.signature: function fromTimestamp(timestamp: number, inSeconds = false): Date
api.summary: Unix milliseconds by default. Pass inSeconds:true for Unix seconds. No magnitude guessing.

api.name: generateBusinessCalendar
api.summary: Generate local calendar days, or midnight instants in config.timezone. workingHours is the nominal shift duration, not elapsed DST duration. Event date ranges include both calendar days; pre-expand recurring events. Event-specific timezone/recurring options are rejected rather than ignored.

api.name: generateDateRange
api.signature: function generateDateRange(options: DateRangeOptions): Date[]
api.summary: Generates an array of dates between a start and end date

api.name: generatePayrollPeriods
api.summary: Calendar-year periods; final end is clipped to year end and includes the final millisecond. Pay date remains the scheduled date even when the period is clipped. No jurisdiction-specific payroll policy.

api.name: generateRecurringDates
api.summary: Includes the supplied start when inside the end bound, even if it does not match a filter. maxOccurrences:0 returns []. Positive integer intervals; finite bounded counts. Custom searches throw after eight years without a match. Month/year recurrences retain the original day anchor after clamping. Weekend/custom intervals count matching occurrences. Weekend generation rejects an all-working-days calendar. Interval is limited to 10,000.

api.name: generateShiftSchedule
api.summary: Manages shift schedules and rotations

api.name: getBusinessDayConfig
api.signature: function getBusinessDayConfig(): BusinessDayConfig
api.summary: Gets the current business day configuration

api.name: getBusinessDays
api.summary: Inclusive local calendar-day count, using configured working days and the union of global, custom, and supplied holidays. Reversed ranges return 0.

api.name: getBusinessDaysInMonth
api.signature: function getBusinessDaysInMonth(year: number, month: number): Date[]
api.summary: Gets an array of all business days in a given month

api.name: getConfigs
api.signature: function getConfigs(): ChronoUtilzConfig
api.summary: Returns available format values, actual loaded holiday rule presets, timezone/locale catalogs and current business configuration. Large catalogs are loaded only when this API is imported.

api.name: getDateDiff
api.summary: date1 minus date2. Elapsed units truncate toward zero. Month differences count calendar month boundaries, quarters truncate that count / 3, and years return month count / 12. These are not full-anniversary differences.

api.name: getDayOfYear
api.signature: function getDayOfYear(date: Date | string | number): number
api.summary: Local calendar ordinal, 1-366, independent of daylight-saving day length.

api.name: getDaysInMonth
api.signature: function getDaysInMonth(date: Date | string | number): number
api.summary: Gets the number of days in a month

api.name: getEarliestDate
api.signature: function getEarliestDate(dateArray: (Date | string | number)[]): Date
api.summary: Gets the earliest date from an array of dates

api.name: getFiscalPeriodAdvanced
api.summary: Fiscal years are named by starting calendar year. startDay is restricted to 1-28 so every quarter has an unambiguous anchor. End includes the final millisecond of the quarter.

api.name: getFiscalQuarter
api.signature: function getFiscalQuarter(date: Date | string | number, fiscalYearStart = 1): number
api.summary: Gets fiscal quarter

api.name: getFiscalYear
api.signature: function getFiscalYear(date: Date | string | number, fiscalYearStart = 1): number
api.summary: Gets fiscal year

api.name: getHolidays
api.signature: function getHolidays(year: number, country = 'US'): Date[]
api.summary: Built-in recurring presets: US federal actual dates and UK England/Wales recurring actual dates. No substitute-day policy, historical rule changes, exceptional proclamations, or complete worldwide calendar. Add validated custom rules/dates for your jurisdiction and year.

api.name: getISOWeek
api.signature: function getISOWeek(date: Date | string | number): number
api.summary: ISO 8601 week number, Monday start and first week containing January 4. Does not return the ISO week-year.

api.name: getLatestDate
api.signature: function getLatestDate(dateArray: (Date | string | number)[]): Date
api.summary: Gets the latest date from an array of dates

api.name: getMidnight
api.signature: function getMidnight(date: Date | string | number): Date
api.summary: Returns a new date set to midnight (00:00:00.000) of the given date

api.name: getMonthBoundaries
api.signature: function getMonthBoundaries(date: Date | string | number): MonthBoundaries
api.summary: Gets the start and end dates of the month containing the given date

api.name: getMonthName
api.summary: Gets month name

api.name: getMonthsInQuarter
api.signature: function getMonthsInQuarter(quarter: number, year: number)
api.summary: Gets detailed information about months in a quarter

api.name: getNextBusinessDay
api.signature: function getNextBusinessDay(date: Date | string | number): Date
api.summary: Gets the next business day from the given date

api.name: getNextHoliday
api.signature: function getNextHoliday(date: Date | string | number, country = 'US'): Date | null
api.summary: Gets the next holiday from a given date

api.name: getNextWorkingHour
api.signature: function getNextWorkingHour(date: Date | string | number, schedule?: WorkingSchedule): Date
api.summary: During a working interval, consume one working hour. Outside it, return the next interval opening.

api.name: getNoon
api.signature: function getNoon(date: Date | string | number): Date
api.summary: Returns a new date set to noon (12:00:00.000) of the given date

api.name: getNthWeekdayOfMonth
api.summary: Gets the nth occurrence of a weekday in a month

api.name: getPayPeriods
api.summary: Anchored at startDate. Semi-monthly uses the anchor then the next 15th/1st; monthly additions clamp month ends. Invalid frequencies throw.

api.name: getPreviousBusinessDay
api.signature: function getPreviousBusinessDay(date: Date | string | number): Date
api.summary: Gets the previous business day from the given date

api.name: getQuarter
api.signature: function getQuarter(date: Date | string): number
api.summary: Returns the quarter number (1-4) for a given date

api.name: getQuarterBoundaries
api.signature: function getQuarterBoundaries(year: number, quarter: number): QuarterBoundaries
api.summary: Gets the start and end dates of the specified quarter in the given year

api.name: getQuarterDate
api.signature: function getQuarterDate(date: Date | string, type: 'start' | 'end'): Date
api.summary: Returns the first or last date of a quarter

api.name: getRelativeTime
api.summary: Returns a relative time string (e.g., "5 minutes ago", "in 2 days")

api.name: getSeason
api.summary: Gets the season for a date

api.name: getTimestamp
api.signature: function getTimestamp(date: Date | string | number, inSeconds = false): number
api.summary: Gets the Unix timestamp for a date

api.name: getTimezoneConfig
api.summary: Get current timezone configuration

api.name: getTimezoneInfo
api.summary: offset is hours east of UTC. isDST is a seasonal offset heuristic, not authoritative historical daylight-saving metadata; Intl does not expose a DST flag. Use offset for calculations.

api.name: getTimezoneOffset
api.signature: function getTimezoneOffset(date: Date | string | number = new Date()): number
api.summary: Gets the timezone offset in minutes

api.name: getTimezonesByOffset
api.summary: Filters the bundled catalog by its static reference offset; use getTimezoneInfo for a date-specific offset.

api.name: getTimezonesByRegion
api.summary: Get all available timezones filtered by region

api.name: getTimezoneString
api.signature: function getTimezoneString(): string
api.summary: Gets a string representation of the current timezone

api.name: getUserTimezone
api.signature: function getUserTimezone(): string
api.summary: Return the host IANA timezone, falling back to UTC when Intl is unavailable.

api.name: getWeekBoundaries
api.summary: Monday start by default; weekStartsOn can be 0-6. startOf/endOf/isSameWeek use Sunday start.

api.name: getWeekOfMonth
api.signature: function getWeekOfMonth(date: Date | string | number): number
api.summary: Gets the week number within a month

api.name: getWeekOfYear
api.signature: function getWeekOfYear(date: Date | string | number): number
api.summary: ISO 8601 week number, Monday start and first week containing January 4. Does not return the ISO week-year.

api.name: getWorkingHoursBetween
api.summary: Gets working hours between two dates

api.name: getYearBoundaries
api.signature: function getYearBoundaries(year: number): YearBoundaries
api.summary: Gets the start and end dates of the specified year

api.name: humanizeDuration
api.summary: Elapsed approximation: 365-day years and 30-day months. Honors unit filtering and precision. Negative values append ago; month abbreviation is mo.

api.summary: Checks if the first date is after the second date

api.name: isBefore
api.summary: Checks if the first date is before the second date

api.name: isBetweenDates
api.summary: Checks if a date is between two other dates

api.summary: Checks if a date is a business day (weekday and not a holiday)

api.summary: Checks if the given date is the first day of the month

api.name: isFirstDayOfYear

api.summary: Checks if the given date is the first day of the year (January 1st)

api.name: isHoliday
api.summary: Checks configured global holidays, custom holidays, and an optional supplied list. Country presets are applied explicitly through getHolidays or WorkingTimeConfig.holidayConfig.

api.name: isLastBusinessDayOfMonth
api.signature: function isLastBusinessDayOfMonth(date: Date | string | number): boolean
api.summary: Checks if a date is the last business day of the month

api.name: isLastDayOfMonth
api.signature: function isLastDayOfMonth(date: Date | string | number): boolean
api.summary: Checks if the given date is the last day of the month

api.name: isLastDayOfYear
api.signature: function isLastDayOfYear(date: Date | string | number): boolean
api.summary: Checks if the given date is the last day of the year (December 31st)

api.name: isLeapYear
api.signature: function isLeapYear(year: number | Date | string): boolean
api.summary: Checks if a year is a leap year

api.signature: function isSameDay(date1: Date | string | number, date2: Date | string | number): boolean
api.summary: Checks if two dates fall on the same day

api.summary: Checks if two dates fall in the same month and year

api.name: isSameWeek

api.summary: Checks if two dates fall in the same week (Sunday-Saturday)

api.name: isSameYear
api.signature: function isSameYear(date1: Date | string | number, date2: Date | string | number): boolean
api.summary: Checks if two dates fall in the same year

api.summary: Validates if a date range is valid (start date is before or equal to end date)

api.summary: Uses configured workingDays; default Monday-Friday.

api.summary: Uses the complement of configured workingDays; default Saturday/Sunday.

api.name: isWithinRange
api.summary: Checks if a date falls within a specified range

api.name: isWorkingHours
api.signature: function isWorkingHours(date: Date | string | number, schedule?: WorkingSchedule): boolean
api.summary: Start-inclusive, end-exclusive. Overnight shifts belong to their starting weekday.

api.summary: Gets the next occurrence of a specific day of week

api.name: parseDate
api.summary: Strict supported ISO, slash and English month-name formats. Offset-bearing inputs preserve the instant. Offset-free inputs use the host timezone unless options.timezone is supplied. Ambiguous slash dates are month-first. Invalid input returns null, a cloned fallback, or throws when requested. No native-parser fallback.

api.name: parseISO
api.signature: function parseISO(isoString: string): Date | null
api.summary: Strict ISO subset: date-only, or T-separated time with optional seconds, 1-3 fractional digits and Z or numeric offset. Date-only is a local calendar date. Invalid dates return null.

api.name: parseMultipleFormats
api.signature: function parseMultipleFormats(dateString: string, formats: string[]): Date | null
api.summary: Tries multiple date formats for parsing

api.name: parseNaturalLanguage
api.summary: Supported English expressions only; options.baseDate and timezone determine relative calculations. Next/last weekday preserves clock time; today/tomorrow/yesterday resolve local midnight. Strict mode throws on unsupported expressions.

api.name: previousOccurrence
api.signature: function previousOccurrence(date: Date | string | number, dayOfWeek: number): Date
api.summary: Gets the previous occurrence of a specific day of week

api.name: randomDate
api.summary: Generates a random date between two dates

api.name: remainingTime
api.summary: target minus reference, with the same units and truncation as getDateDiff.

api.name: removeDuplicateDates
api.summary: Filters invalid entries and keeps the first original instant at each requested calendar precision.

api.name: resetBusinessDayConfig

api.name: roundToNearest
api.summary: Rounds a date to the nearest specified unit

api.summary: Search timezones by description or ID
